stepBody:
As part of a market expansion, Raising Cane's tests a custom profit forecasting model for Berkeley, using a custom objective function to optimize predicted monthly profits.
The objective function is defined as:
$$L(	heta_0,	heta_1)= rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i- rac{\log(	heta_0)}{	heta_0}-	heta_1x_i+	heta_{0}	heta_1)$$
$$ rac{\partial{L}}{\partial{	heta}}(	heta_0,	heta_1)= rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(- rac{1-\log(	heta_0)}{	heta_0**{2}}+	heta_1,(A))$$
Complete the gradient vector by calculating blank (A).
